license.content_restriction: Due to licensing restrictions, a GenCC download does not include OMIM data. OMIM data can be accessed and downloaded through https://www.omim.org/ (https://thegencc.org/download). The snapshot is built only from that download and therefore carries no OMIM content beyond what the export itself contains.
